questions.q: The moment of inertia of a circular ring of mass $M$ and diameter r about a tangential axis lying in the plane of the ring is :

Diameter is given as R.
$\begin{aligned}
& \therefore \text { Radius }=\mathrm{R} / 2 \\ & \mathrm{I}_{\text {tan gent }}=\frac{3}{2} \mathrm{~m}\left(\frac{\mathrm{R}}{2}\right)^2=\frac{3}{8} \mathrm{mR}^2

questions.q: A stationary horizontal disc is free to rotate about its axis. When a torque is applied on it, its kinetic energy as a function of $\theta$, where $\theta$ is the angle by which it has rotated, is given as $k{\theta}^{2}$. If its moment of inertia is $I$ then the angular acceleration of the disc is:
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Kinetic Energy $= k{\theta}^{2}$
$\dfrac{1}{2}I{\omega}^{2} = k{\theta}^{2}$
${\omega}^{2} = \dfrac{2k{\theta}^{2}}{I}$
Differentiate both side w.r.t. $\theta$ .
$2\omega\dfrac{d\omega}{d\theta} = \dfrac{4k\theta}{I}$
$\omega\dfrac{d\omega}{d\theta} = \dfrac{2k\theta}{I}$
$\alpha = \dfrac{2k\theta}{I}$

questions.q: A fly wheel is accelerated uniformly from rest and rotates through& $5rad$ in the first second. The angle rotated by the fly wheel in the next second, will be :
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Here the angular acceleration is constant, so we have,

$\theta = \omegat + \dfrac{1}{2}\alphat^{2}$.

When flywheel is rotated from rest in the first second, then~${θ}_{1} = \dfrac{1}{2}\alpha\left(1\right)2 = 5rad$

$⇒ \alpha = 10rads^{- 2}$

The angle turned by flywheel in the next second is~${θ}_{2} = \dfrac{1}{2}\alpha\left(2\right)2 = \dfrac{1}{2}\left(10\right)\left(4\right) = 20rads^{- 2}$

Thus, the angle turned during next second~is~$\theta = 20 - 5 = 15rad$

questions.q:
A block of mass& $m = 1kg$ slides with velocity~$v = 6ms^{- 1}$ on a frictionless horizontal surface and collides with a uniform vertical rod and sticks to it as shown. The rod is pivoted about~$O$ and swings as a result of the collision making angle~$\theta$ before momentarily coming to rest. if the rod has mass $M = 2kg,$ and length~$ℓ = 1m,$ the value of~$\theta$ is approximately \left( takeg = 10ms^{- 2}\right)$

$
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Angular momentum

$mvl = \left(ml^{2} + \dfrac{2ml^{2}}{3}\right)\omega$

$mvl = \dfrac{5}{3}ml^{2}\omega$

$\omega = \dfrac{3v}{5l}$

$\dfrac{1}{2}{Iω}^{2} = 2mg\dfrac{l}{2} \left(1 - cos\theta\right) +mgl \left($1 - $cos\theta\right)

\dfrac{1}{2} \left(\dfrac{5}{3}ml^{2}\$right)\dfrac{9v^{2}}{25l^{2}} =$2mgl \left(1 - cos\theta\right)$

$\dfrac{3}{5 \times 2}{mv}^{2} =2mgl \left($1 - cos $\theta\right)

\dfrac{3}{10} \times \dfrac{36}{2 \times 10} =$1 - $cos\theta

$1 - $\dfrac{27}{50} =cos\theta

cos\theta = \dfrac{23}{50} =$0 . 46$

\theta = \cos^{- 1}\left($0 . 46\right) = 63 °$

$

questions.q: A sphere of mass $2$ kg and radius $0 . 5m$ is rolling with an initial speed of $1\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm\mathrm{ms}^{-1}$ goes up an inclined plane which makes an angle of $30 °$ with the horizontal plane, without slipping. How low will the sphere take to return to the starting point $A$?

$a = \dfrac{gsin\theta}{1 + \dfrac{I}{mR^{2}}} = \dfrac{5}{7} \times \dfrac{10}{2} = \dfrac{25}{7}$

$t = \dfrac{2{v}_{0}}{a} = \dfrac{2 \times 1 \times 7}{25}= 0 . 56$.

questions.q: Ratio of radius of gyration of a hollow sphere to that of a solid cylinder of equal mass, for moment of Inertia about their diameter axis $\mathrm{AB}$ as shown in figure is $\sqrt{8 / x}$. The value of $x$ is :
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{I}_{\text {sphere }}=\frac{2}{3} \mathrm{MR}^2=\mathrm{Mk}_1^2 \\ & \mathrm{I}_{\text {cylinder }}=\frac{1}{12} \mathrm{M}\left(4 \mathrm{R}^2\right)+\frac{1}{4} \mathrm{MR}^2+\mathrm{M}(2 \mathrm{R})^2 \\ & =\frac{67}{12} \mathrm{MR}^2=\mathrm{Mk}_2^2 \\ & \frac{\mathrm{k}_1}{\mathrm{k}_2}=\sqrt{\frac{2}{3} \cdot \frac{12}{67}}=\sqrt{\frac{8}{67}}\end{aligned}$

questions.q:
An object of mass $8$ kg is hanging from one end of a uniform rod $CD$ of mass $2$ kg and length $1m$ pivoted at its end $C$ on a vertical wall as shown in figure. It is supported by a cable $AB$ such that the system is in equilibrium. The tension in the cable is:

(Take~$g = 10ms^{- 2}$)
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Let& $T$~be the tension in cable.

Since the system~is at equilibrium, the net torque, about an axis perpendicular to the plane and passing through the point of contact of the rod and~the wall, is zero. Therefore, torque about point $C$

$Tsin30 ° \times 60 = mg \times 50 + 8g \times 100$

$\dfrac{T}{2} \times 60 = 20 \times 50 + 80 \times 100$

$⇒ 3T = 100 + 800$

$⇒ 300N$.

questions.q: The time dependence of the position of a particle of mass $m = 2$ is given by $\overset{→}{r}\left(t\right) = 2t\overset{^}{i} - 3t^{2}\overset{^}{j}$ . Its angular momentum, with respect to the origin, at time $t = 2$ is:
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
$\overset{→}{r} = 2t\overset{^}{i} - 3t^{2}\overset{^}{j}$
$\overset{→}{v} = 2\overset{^}{i} - 6t\overset{^}{j}$
Momentum $\overset{→}{p} = m\overset{→}{v}$
$= 4\overset{^}{i} - 12t\overset{^}{j}$
$∴$ angular momentum $\overset{→}{L} = \overset{→}{r} \times \overset{→}{p}$
$= \left(2t\overset{^}{i} - 3t^{2}\overset{^}{j}\$right)\times\left(4\overset{^}{i} - 12t\overset{^}{j}\right)$
$= - 24t^{2}\overset{^}{k} + 12t^{2}\overset{^}{k}$
$= - 12t^{2}\overset{^}{k}$
At time $t = 2$
$\overset{→}{L} = - 48\overset{^}{k}$$

questions.q: A solid spherical ball is rolling on a frictionless horizontal plane surface about its axis of symmetry. The ratio of rotational kinetic energy of the ball to its total kinetic energy is
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Under pure rolling condition:& $v = \omegaR$

Translational~$K . E = \dfrac{1}{2}mv^{2}$

Rotational~$K . E = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \dfrac{2}{5}mR^{2}\left(\dfrac{v}{R}\right)2 = \dfrac{1}{5}mv^{2}$

Total~$K . E = \dfrac{1}{2}mv^{2} + \dfrac{1}{5}mv^{2} = \dfrac{7}{10}mv^{2}$

So,~$\dfrac{RotationalK \cdot E}{TotalK \cdot E} = \dfrac{\dfrac{1}{5}mv^{2}}{\dfrac{7}{10}mv^{2}} = \dfrac{2}{7}$

questions.q: A homogeneous solid cylindrical roller of radius $R$ and mass $M$ is pulled on a cricket pitch by a horizontal force. Assuming rolling without slipping, angular acceleration of the cylinder is:
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
$F - {f}_{r} = ma\ldots \left(i\right)$

${f}_{r}R = I\alpha = $\dfrac{mR^{2}}{2}\alpha\ldots ($ii )$

For pure rolling

$a = \alphaR\ldots ( iii )$

From \left(i\right), ( ii )$ and $( iii )$

$F - $\dfrac{mR\alpha}{2} =$m\alphaR$

$F = $\ddfrac{3}{2}mR\alpha$

$\alpha = \dfrac{2F}{3mR}$

$

questions.q: A ball of mass $0 . 5kg$ is attached to a string of length $50$ cm. The ball is rotated on a horizontal circular path about its vertical axis. The maximum tension that the string can bear is $400N$. The maximum possible value of angular velocity of the ball in $rads^{- 1}$ is,:
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Let the string makes angle $\theta$ with the vertical. Weight will be balanced by the vertical component of tension, which is $Tcos\theta = mg$ and the horizontal component towards the centre will provide the required centripetal force for circular motion. Therefore,

$Tsin\theta = m{ω}^{2} \left($lsin$\theta\right), where $l =$length of the string.

$⇒ 400sin$\theta =$0 .5 {ω}^{2} $\times$0 .5 sin$\theta

$⇒ $\omega =$40rads^{- 1}$

$

questions.q:
Electric field of a plane electromagnetic wave propagating through a non-magnetic medium is given by $E = 20cos\left(2 \times {10}^{10}t - 200x\right)Vm^{- 1} .$~The dielectric constant of the medium is equal to:
(Take ${μ}_{r} = 1 )$
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Equate the wave equation with the equation of EM wave,& $E = {E}_{0}cos\left(\omegat - kx\right)Vm^{- 1}$~here~the given equation of EM wave, $E = 20cos\left(2 \times {10}^{10}t - 200x\right)Vm^{- 1}⇒ v = \dfrac{ω}{k} = \dfrac{2 \times {10}^{10}}{200} = {10}^{8}ms^{- 1}$
The refractive index,$⇒ n = \dfrac{c}{v} = \dfrac{3 \times {10}^{8}}{108} ⇒ 3 = \sqrt{{μ}_{r}{ε}_{r}}\left({μ}_{r} = 1\right\text{given} )$
${ε}_{r} = 9$

questions.q: A rectangular solid box of length $0.3m$ is held horizontally, with one of its sides on the edge of a platform of height $5m$ . When released, it slips off the table in a very short time $τ = 0.01s$ , remaining essentially horizontal. The angle by which it would rotate when it hits the ground will be (in radians) close to:
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Angular impulse = change in angular momentum
$τ\Deltat = \Delta L$
$mg\dfrac{l}{2} \times 0.01 = \dfrac{ml^{2}}{3}\omega$
$\omega = \dfrac{3g \times 0.01}{2l} = \dfrac{3 \times 10 \times 0.01}{2 \times 0.3} = 0.5rad / sec$
Time taken by rod to hit the ground = $\sqrt{\dfrac{2h}{g}} = \sqrt{\dfrac{2 \times 5}{10}} = 1s$
Angle rotated by rod = $\omegat = 0.5 \times 1 = 0.5rad$

questions.q: A solid sphere of mass ' $m$ ' and radius ' $r$ ' is allowed to roll without slipping from the highest point of an inclined plane of length ' $L$ ' and makes an angle $30^{{}^{{}^{\circ}}}$ with the horizontal. The speed of the particle at the bottom of the plane is $v_1$. If the angle of inclination is increased to $45^{{}^{{}^{\circ}}}$ while keeping $L$ constant. Then the new speed of the sphere at the bottom of the plane is $v_2$. The ratio $v_1^2: v_2^2$ is
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution: using WET $\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{W}_{\mathrm{g}}=\mathrm{k}_{\mathrm{f}}-\mathrm{k}_{\mathrm{i}} \\ & \mathrm{Mg} \mathrm{~L} \sin \theta=\mathrm{k}_{\mathrm{f}}-\mathrm{k}_{\mathrm{i}} \end{aligned}$ K.E. in pure rolling $\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{mV}_{\mathrm{cm}}^2+\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{I}_{\mathrm{cm}} \omega^2\begin{aligned} & =\frac{1}{2} \mathrm{mV}^2+\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{2}{5} \mathrm{mR}^2 \frac{\mathrm{~V}^2}{\mathrm{R}^2} \\ & \frac{7}{10} \mathrm{mV}^2 \end{aligned}\mathrm{mgL} \sin \theta=\frac{7}{10} \mathrm{mV}_{\mathrm{f}}^2-0\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{V}_{\mathrm{f}}^2 \propto \sin \theta \\ & \left(\frac{\mathrm{~V}_1}{\mathrm{~V}_2}\right)^2=\frac{\sin \theta_1}{\sin \theta_2}=\frac{\sin 30^{{}^{{}^{\circ}}}}{\sin 45^{{}^{{}^{\circ}}}}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{2}} \end{aligned}$

questions.q: Consider two uniform discs of the same thickness and different radii ${R}_{1} = R$~and~${R}_{2} = \alphaR$ made of the same material. If the ratio of their moments of inertia~${I}_{1}$~and~${I}_{2}$, respectively, about their axes is~${I}_{1}: {I}_{2} = 1: 16$~then the value of~$\alpha$& is :
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Moment of inertia of disc is given by& $I = \dfrac{MR2}{2} = \dfrac{\left[ρ\left({πR}^{2}\right)t\right]R^{2}}{2}$

$I\alphaR^{4}$

$\dfrac{I2}{I1} = \left(\dfrac{R2}{R1}\right)4$

$\dfrac{16}{1} = {α}^{4}$

$\alpha = 2$&

questions.q: A sphere of radius $a$~and mass $m$ rolls along a horizontal plane with constant speed ${v}_{0}$. It encounters an inclined plane at angle $\theta$ and climbs upward. Assuming that it rolls without slipping, how far up the sphere will travel?
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
From energy conservation
$mgh = \dfrac{1}{2}{mv}_{0}^{2} + \dfrac{1}{2}{Iω}^{2}$
$⇒ mgh = \dfrac{1}{2}{mv}_{0}^{2} + \dfrac{1}{2} \times \dfrac{2}{5}{ma}^{2} \times {v}_{0}^{2}a^{2}$
$⇒ gh = \dfrac{1}{2}{v}_{0}^{2} + \dfrac{1}{5}{v}_{0}^{2}$
$⇒ gh = \dfrac{7}{10}{v}_{0}^{2}$

From triangle, $sin\theta = \dfrac{h}{l}$
Then $h = lsin\theta$
$⇒ lsin\theta = \dfrac{7}{10}{v}_{0}^{2}g$
Thus, the sphere will travel distance,~$l = \dfrac{7}{10}\dfrac{{v}_{0}2}{gsin\theta}$.

questions.q: The moment of inertia of a semicircular ring about an axis, passing through the center and perpendicular to the plane of ring, is$\dfrac{1}{x}{MR}^{2}$, where $R$ is the radius and $M$ is the mass of the semicircular ring. The value of $x$ will be~_______.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
The moment of inertia of a semicircular ring about a line perpendicular to the plane of the ring and passing through its centre is given as$I= MR^{2}$,~where $m$ and$R$ are the mass and radius of the ring. Comparing the given value

.$I = {MR}^{2} = \dfrac{1}{x}MR^{2}$

$⇒ x = 1$

questions.q: A body of mass $5$ kg moving with a uniform speed $3\sqrt{2}ms^{- 1}$ in $X - Y$ plane along the line $y = x + 4$. The angular momentum of the particle about the origin will be _______kgm^{2}s^{- 1}.
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
Equation of line given: $y - x - 4 = 0$.

Let ${d}_{1}$ be the perpendicular distance of given line from origin.

${d}_{1} = \left|\dfrac{- 4}{{1}^{2} + {1}^{2}}\right| = 2\sqrt{2}$

So, $| \overset{→}{L} | = mv{d}_{1} = 5 \times 3\sqrt{2} \times 2\sqrt{2}kgm^{2}s^{- 1}$

$= 60kgm^{2}s^{- 1}$

questions.q: A cylinder is rolling down on an inclined plane of inclination $60 °$. Its acceleration during rolling down will be $\dfrac{x}{3}ms^{- 2}$, where $x =$ _______(use $g = 10ms^{- 2}$).
questions.subject: Physics
questions.solution:
For rolling motion, the acceleration of the cylinder along the inclined plane can be expressed as

$a = \dfrac{gsin\theta}{1 + \dfrac{Icm}{MR^{2}}} . . . \left(1\right)$

The moment of inertia of the cylinder can be written as

${I}_{cm} = $\dfrac{1}{2}$MR^{2} . . . \left(2\right)$

From equations (1) and (2), it follows that

$\begin{cases}a & = & \dfrac{gsin\theta}{1 + \dfrac{1}{2}}\\ & = & \dfrac{2 \times 10 \times \dfrac{3}{2}}{3}\\ & = & \dfrac{10}{3}ms^{- 2}\end{cases}$

Therefore, $x = 10$.
